stages.name: keywords

stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "alias_id",NULL AS "alias_source",NULL AS "module_name_id","module_name_start","module_name_end","module_name_kind","module_name_source","value","expr_kind","expr_text","fn" FROM (SELECT n.*,v.id AS value,v.kind AS expr_kind,v.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='return_statement')

stages.name: parameters
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn",NULL AS "id",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "text","name","annotation",NULL AS "position" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,p.id,p.kind,p.text,n.text AS name,p.type_id AS annotation,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.id ORDER BY p.__start)-1 AS position FROM functions f JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=f.__path AND p.parent=f.parameters_id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.id=CASE WHEN p.kind='identifier' THEN p.id ELSE (SELECT child.id FROM nodes child WHERE child.__path=p.__path AND child.parent=p.id AND child.ordinal=0 AND child.kind='identifier' LIMIT 1) END
 WHERE p.kind IN ('identifier','typed_parameter','default_parameter','typed_default_parameter'))

stages.name: declarations
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id","parent",NULL AS "edge_parent","kind",NULL AS "line","text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source","body_id","body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "alias_id",NULL AS "alias_source",NULL AS "module_name_id","module_name_start","module_name_end","module_name_kind","module_name_source","name","region_start" FROM (SELECT n.*,n.name_source name,coalesce(w.__start,n.__start) region_start FROM nodes n LEFT JOIN nodes w ON w.__path=n.__path AND w.id=n.parent AND w.kind='decorated_definition' WHERE n.kind IN ('function_definition','class_definition'))

stages.name: declaration_links
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","lexical_parent" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE parent(__path,root,node) AS (SELECT __path,id,parent FROM declarations UNION ALL SELECT p.__path,p.root,n.parent FROM parent p JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.id=p.node WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('function_definition','class_definition')) SELECT p.__path,p.root id,d.id lexical_parent FROM parent p JOIN declarations d ON d.__path=p.__path AND d.id=p.node)

stages.name: declaration_contexts
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id","parent",NULL AS "edge_parent","kind",NULL AS "line","text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source","body_id","body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "alias_id",NULL AS "alias_source",NULL AS "module_name_id","module_name_start","module_name_end","module_name_kind","module_name_source","name","region_start","qualname","lexical_parent" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE qualified(__path,id,qualname,lexical_parent) AS (SELECT d.__path,d.id,d.name,NULL FROM declarations d WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM declaration_links link WHERE link.__path=d.__path AND link.id=d.id) UNION ALL SELECT d.__path,d.id,q.qualname||'.'||d.name,q.id FROM qualified q JOIN declaration_links link ON link.__path=q.__path AND link.lexical_parent=q.id JOIN declarations d ON d.__path=link.__path AND d.id=link.id) SELECT d.*,q.qualname,q.lexical_parent FROM declarations d JOIN qualified q ON q.__path=d.__path AND q.id=d.id)

stages.name: decorator_names
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn",NULL AS "decorator","node","name" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,fn,decorator,node) AS (
        SELECT f.__path,f.id,d.id,x.id FROM declarations f JOIN nodes wrapper ON wrapper.__path=f.__path AND wrapper.id=f.parent AND wrapper.kind='decorated_definition' JOIN nodes d ON d.__path=wrapper.__path AND d.parent=wrapper.id AND d.kind='decorator' JOIN nodes x ON x.__path=d.__path AND x.parent=d.id
        UNION ALL SELECT w.__path,w.fn,w.decorator,c.callee_id FROM walk w JOIN calls c ON c.__path=w.__path AND c.id=w.node)
        SELECT w.__path,w.fn,w.decorator,w.node,coalesce(a.attr,n.text) name FROM walk w JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=w.__path AND n.id=w.node LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=n.__path AND a.id=n.id WHERE n.kind IN ('identifier','attribute'))

stages.name: expression_roots
stages.query: SELECT "__path","expression",NULL AS "id","name",NULL AS "through_call" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE root(__path,expression,node,through_call) AS (SELECT __path,id,id,0 FROM nodes UNION ALL SELECT r.__path,r.expression,c.id,r.through_call OR n.kind='call' FROM root r JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=r.__path AND n.id=r.node JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.id=CASE WHEN n.kind='attribute' THEN n.object_id WHEN n.kind='subscript' THEN n.value_id WHEN n.kind='call' THEN n.function_id WHEN n.kind IN ('parenthesized_expression','type') THEN (SELECT child.id FROM nodes child WHERE child.__path=n.__path AND child.parent=n.id AND child.ordinal=0 LIMIT 1) END) SELECT r.__path,r.expression,n.id,n.text name,r.through_call FROM root r JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=r.__path AND n.id=r.node WHERE n.kind='identifier')

stages.name: imports
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","__start","__end","module","local","name","kind","fn" FROM (SELECT n.__path,n.id,n.__start,n.__end,CASE WHEN n.kind='future_import_statement' THEN '__future__' ELSE n.module_name_source END module,coalesce(x.alias_source,x.name_source,x.text) local,coalesce(x.name_source,x.text) name,CASE WHEN n.kind='future_import_statement' THEN 'import_from_statement' ELSE n.kind END kind,owner.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes x ON x.__path=n.__path AND x.parent=n.id AND x.kind IN ('dotted_name','aliased_import') AND x.id IS NOT n.module_name_id JOIN ownership owner ON owner.__path=n.__path AND owner.id=n.id WHERE n.kind IN ('import_statement','import_from_statement','future_import_statement'))

stages.name: analyzer_functions
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line","text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source","body_id","body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "alias_id",NULL AS "alias_source",NULL AS "module_name_id","module_name_start","module_name_end","module_name_kind","module_name_source","name","region_start","qualname","lexical_parent","symbol","sensitive","bootstrap","reconciliation" FROM (SELECT f.*,replace(substr(f.__path,1,length(f.__path)-3),'/','.')||'.'||f.qualname symbol,
        rx_matches(f.__path,'^(?:l7450_versioned_revert/|l8100_ops_analytics/)') OR f.__path IN ('impl/common/l7300_revision_history/revision_history_query_impl.py','l7200_versioned_transactions/versioned_lazy_mixin.py') OR rx_matches(f.__path,'^(?:l7200_versioned_transactions/_lint_|impl/common/l7300_revision_history/_lint_)') sensitive,
rx_matches(lower(f.__path||' '||f.qualname),'bootstrap|ddl') bootstrap,
rx_matches(lower(f.__path||' '||f.qualname),'reconcile|reconciliation|schema_ensure') OR f.__path IN ('l2000_connection/schema_transaction.py','l2000_connection/table_existence_authority.py','impl/common/l2200_sql_dialect/schema_ensure.py','impl/common/l2200_sql_dialect/sql_schema_services.py','impl/common/l2200_sql_dialect/sql_core_support_free_functions.py','impl/common/l2200_sql_dialect/sql_core_support_mixin.py') reconciliation
        FROM declaration_contexts f JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=f.__path AND parent.id=f.parent LEFT JOIN nodes grand ON grand.__path=parent.__path AND grand.id=parent.parent LEFT JOIN nodes great ON great.__path=grand.__path AND great.id=grand.parent
        WHERE f.kind='function_definition' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM declaration_contexts a WHERE a.__path=f.__path AND a.kind='function_definition' AND a.region_start<f.region_start AND a.__end>=f.__end) AND (parent.kind='module' OR parent.kind='decorated_definition' AND grand.kind='module' OR parent.kind='block' AND grand.kind='class_definition' OR parent.kind='decorated_definition' AND grand.kind='block' AND great.kind='class_definition'))

stages.name: pruned_functions
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT f.__path,f.id FROM declarations f JOIN decorator_names d ON d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id JOIN nodes expr ON expr.__path=d.__path AND expr.id=d.node WHERE f.kind='function_definition' AND expr.kind='attribute' AND d.name IN ('delete','get','patch','post','put'))

stages.name: assignment_targets
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id" FROM (SELECT __path,target id FROM assignments)

stages.name: owned_nodes
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","id","__start","__end","kind","text","visit_key" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,fn,id,visit_key) AS (
        SELECT __path,id,body_id,'' FROM analyzer_functions
        UNION ALL SELECT o.__path,o.fn,n.id,o.visit_key||CASE
        WHEN current.kind='dictionary' AND n.kind='pair' THEN ''
        WHEN current.kind='pair' THEN printf('%020d/%020d/',n.ordinal,current.ordinal)
        WHEN current.kind='argument_list' THEN printf('%020d/%020d/',n.kind='keyword_argument',n.ordinal)
        WHEN current.kind='conditional_expression' THEN printf('%020d/',CASE n.ordinal WHEN 0 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 0 ELSE n.ordinal END)
        ELSE printf('%020d/',n.ordinal) END FROM owned o JOIN nodes current ON current.__path=o.__path AND current.id=o.id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=o.__path AND n.parent=o.id
        WHERE n.kind!='class_definition' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignment_targets target WHERE target.__path=n.__path AND target.id=n.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pruned_functions p WHERE p.__path=n.__path AND p.id=n.id))
        SELECT o.__path,o.fn,n.id,n.__start,n.__end,n.kind,n.text,o.visit_key FROM owned o JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=o.__path AND n.id=o.id)

stages.name: alias_regions
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "id","__start","__end" FROM (SELECT b.__path,b.id,b.__start,b.__end FROM nodes b JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=b.__path AND parent.id=b.parent WHERE b.kind='block' AND parent.kind IN ('if_statement','elif_clause','else_clause','for_statement','while_statement','try_statement','except_clause','finally_clause','case_clause','function_definition'))

stages.name: scoped_assignments
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end",NULL AS "id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "alias_id",NULL AS "alias_source",NULL AS "module_name_id","module_name_start","module_name_end","module_name_kind","module_name_source","target","target_kind","target_text","value","expr_kind","expr_text","fn","scope_start","scope_end" FROM (SELECT a.*,coalesce((SELECT b.__start FROM alias_regions b WHERE b.__path=a.__path AND b.__start<=a.__start AND b.__end>=a.__end ORDER BY b.__start DESC LIMIT 1),0) scope_start,coalesce((SELECT b.__end FROM alias_regions b WHERE b.__path=a.__path AND b.__start<=a.__start AND b.__end>=a.__end ORDER BY b.__start DESC LIMIT 1),2147483647) scope_end FROM assignments a WHERE a.target_kind='identifier')

stages.name: visible_bindings
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","node","value" FROM (SELECT __path,fn,node,value FROM (SELECT r.__path,r.fn,r.id node,a.value,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY r.__path,r.fn,r.id ORDER BY a.__start DESC) chosen FROM owned_nodes r JOIN analyzer_functions f ON f.__path=r.__path AND f.id=r.fn JOIN scoped_assignments a ON a.__path=r.__path AND a.target_text=r.text AND a.__end<r.__start AND a.__start>=f.body_start AND a.scope_start<=r.__start AND a.scope_end>=r.__end WHERE r.kind='identifier') WHERE chosen=1)

stages.name: class_method_aliases
stages.query: SELECT "__path","cls",NULL AS "qualname","name","target","__start" FROM (SELECT a.__path,d.id cls,d.qualname,a.target_text name,a.expr_text target,a.__start FROM assignments a JOIN nodes stmt ON stmt.__path=a.__path AND stmt.id=a.parent JOIN declaration_contexts d ON d.__path=stmt.__path AND d.kind='class_definition' AND stmt.parent=d.body_id WHERE a.target_kind='identifier' AND a.expr_kind='identifier' AND a.type_start IS NULL)

stages.name: module_alias_bindings
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","name","target" FROM (SELECT a.__path,a.target_text name,
        CASE WHEN a.expr_kind='identifier' THEN a.expr_text WHEN a.expr_kind='attribute' THEN attr.attr
          WHEN a.expr_kind='call' AND call.callee_kind='identifier' THEN call.callee END target
        FROM assignments a JOIN nodes expression ON expression.__path=a.__path AND expression.id=a.parent
        JOIN nodes module ON module.__path=expression.__path AND module.id=expression.parent AND module.kind='module'
        LEFT JOIN attributes attr ON attr.__path=a.__path AND attr.id=a.value
        LEFT JOIN calls call ON call.__path=a.__path AND call.id=a.value
        WHERE a.target_kind='identifier' AND a.type_start IS NULL
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments later JOIN nodes e ON e.__path=later.__path AND e.id=later.parent
          WHERE later.__path=a.__path AND later.target_text=a.target_text AND later.target_kind='identifier'
          AND later.type_start IS NULL AND e.parent=module.id AND later.__start>a.__start))

stages.name: module_aliases
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","name","resolved" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE resolution(__path,root,token,seen) AS (
        SELECT __path,name,name,','||name||',' FROM module_alias_bindings
        UNION ALL SELECT r.__path,r.root,b.target,r.seen||b.target||',' FROM resolution r
          JOIN module_alias_bindings b ON b.__path=r.__path AND b.name=r.token
          WHERE b.target IS NOT NULL AND instr(r.seen,','||b.target||',')=0),
        terminal AS (SELECT r.__path,r.root,CASE WHEN b.target IS NOT NULL THEN b.target ELSE r.token END token
          FROM resolution r LEFT JOIN module_alias_bindings b ON b.__path=r.__path AND b.name=r.token
          WHERE b.target IS NULL OR instr(r.seen,','||b.target||',')>0)
        SELECT r.__path,r.root name,coalesce((SELECT i.module||'.'||i.name FROM imports i
          WHERE i.__path=r.__path AND i.fn IS NULL AND i.kind='import_from_statement' AND i.local=r.token),r.token) resolved
        FROM terminal r)

stages.name: native_cursor_parameters
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","name" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE annotation(__path,fn,name,node) AS (
        SELECT __path,fn,name,annotation FROM parameters WHERE annotation IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL SELECT a.__path,a.fn,a.name,child.id FROM annotation a
          JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=a.__path AND n.id=a.node
          JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=n.__path AND child.id=CASE WHEN n.kind='subscript' THEN n.value_id
            ELSE (SELECT first.id FROM nodes first WHERE first.__path=n.__path AND first.parent=n.id AND first.ordinal=0 LIMIT 1) END
          WHERE n.kind IN ('type','generic_type','subscript'))
        SELECT a.__path,a.fn,a.name FROM annotation a JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=a.__path AND n.id=a.node
        JOIN imports i ON i.__path=a.__path AND i.fn IS NULL AND (
          n.kind='identifier' AND i.kind='import_from_statement' AND i.local=n.text
          OR n.kind='attribute' AND i.kind='import_statement' AND i.local=n.object_source)
        WHERE CASE WHEN n.kind='identifier' THEN i.module||'.'||i.name ELSE i.name||'.'||n.attribute_source END
          IN ('psycopg.Cursor','psycopg.AsyncCursor','sqlite3.Cursor'))

stages.name: terminal_values
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","root","value" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE terminal(__path,fn,root,node,depth,seen) AS (
        SELECT __path,fn,id,id,0,','||id||',' FROM owned_nodes WHERE kind IN ('identifier','attribute','call','parenthesized_expression')
        UNION ALL SELECT t.__path,t.fn,t.root,next.id,t.depth+1,t.seen||next.id||',' FROM terminal t JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.id=t.node LEFT JOIN visible_bindings binding ON binding.__path=n.__path AND binding.fn=t.fn AND binding.node=n.id JOIN nodes next ON next.__path=n.__path AND next.id=CASE WHEN n.kind='identifier' THEN binding.value WHEN n.kind='call' THEN n.function_id WHEN n.kind='parenthesized_expression' THEN (SELECT child.id FROM nodes child WHERE child.__path=n.__path AND child.parent=n.id AND child.ordinal=0 LIMIT 1) END WHERE t.depth<64 AND instr(t.seen,','||next.id||',')=0)
        SELECT t.__path,t.fn,t.root,CASE WHEN n.kind='attribute' THEN n.attribute_source ELSE coalesce((SELECT a.resolved FROM module_aliases a WHERE a.__path=n.__path AND a.name=n.text),(SELECT i.module||'.'||i.name FROM imports i WHERE i.__path=n.__path AND i.local=n.text AND i.kind='import_from_statement' AND (i.fn IS NULL OR i.fn=t.fn) ORDER BY i.__start DESC LIMIT 1),n.text) END value FROM terminal t JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.id=t.node WHERE n.kind='attribute' OR n.kind='identifier' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM visible_bindings b WHERE b.__path=n.__path AND b.fn=t.fn AND b.node=n.id))

stages.name: execution_context_classes
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","cls" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE heads(__path,cls,node) AS (
      SELECT c.__path,c.id,b.id FROM declaration_contexts c JOIN nodes args ON args.__path=c.__path AND args.parent=c.id AND args.kind='argument_list' JOIN nodes b ON b.__path=args.__path AND b.parent=args.id WHERE c.kind='class_definition'
      UNION ALL SELECT h.__path,h.cls,n.function_id FROM heads h JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=h.__path AND n.id=h.node AND n.kind='call')
      SELECT DISTINCT h.__path,h.cls FROM heads h JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=h.__path AND n.id=h.node WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND n.text GLOB '*ExecutionContext' OR n.kind='attribute' AND n.attribute_source GLOB '*ExecutionContext')

stages.name: function_flags
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line","text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "alias_id",NULL AS "alias_source",NULL AS "module_name_id","module_name_start","module_name_end","module_name_kind","module_name_source","name","region_start","qualname","lexical_parent","symbol","sensitive","bootstrap","reconciliation","fact_order","execution_context","tombstone","pure","legacy","is_lazy","is_public" FROM (SELECT base.*,(base.pure OR base.name GLOB '*_lazy') is_lazy,base.name NOT GLOB '_*' is_public FROM (SELECT f.*,coalesce((SELECT group_concat(piece,'') FROM (SELECT printf('%020d/1/',d.region_start) piece FROM declarations d WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.kind='class_definition' AND d.region_start<f.region_start AND d.__end>=f.__end ORDER BY d.region_start)),'')||printf('%020d',f.region_start) fact_order,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM execution_context_classes ctx JOIN declaration_contexts cls ON cls.__path=ctx.__path AND cls.id=ctx.cls WHERE cls.__path=f.__path AND cls.region_start<f.region_start AND cls.__end>=f.__end) AND f.name IN ('execute_sync','execute_async') execution_context,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes stmt LEFT JOIN nodes value ON value.__path=stmt.__path AND value.parent=stmt.id AND value.ordinal=0 LEFT JOIN calls call ON call.__path=value.__path AND call.id=value.id WHERE stmt.__path=f.__path AND stmt.parent=f.body_id AND stmt.kind='raise_statement' AND (CASE WHEN value.kind='call' THEN call.callee WHEN value.kind='attribute' THEN value.attribute_source WHEN value.kind='identifier' THEN value.text END GLOB '*NotImplementedError' OR CASE WHEN value.kind='call' THEN call.callee WHEN value.kind='attribute' THEN value.attribute_source WHEN value.kind='identifier' THEN value.text END GLOB '*LazyPurityError')
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes prior WHERE prior.__path=stmt.__path AND prior.parent=stmt.parent AND prior.__start<stmt.__start AND prior.kind!='comment' AND NOT(prior.kind='expression_statement' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes doc WHERE doc.__path=prior.__path AND doc.parent=prior.id AND doc.kind IN ('string','concatenated_string'))))) tombstone,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorator_names d LEFT JOIN imports i ON i.__path=d.__path AND i.local=d.name AND i.fn IS NULL WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id AND rx_extract(coalesce((SELECT a.resolved FROM module_aliases a WHERE a.__path=d.__path AND a.name=d.name),i.module||'.'||i.name,d.name),'[^.]+$',0)='pure_lazy') pure,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorator_names d LEFT JOIN imports i ON i.__path=d.__path AND i.local=d.name AND i.fn IS NULL WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id AND rx_extract(coalesce((SELECT a.resolved FROM module_aliases a WHERE a.__path=d.__path AND a.name=d.name),i.module||'.'||i.name,d.name),'[^.]+$',0) IN ('legacy_sync','legacy_async','legacy_module_sync','legacy_module_async')) legacy FROM analyzer_functions f) base)

stages.name: owned_calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "alias_id",NULL AS "alias_source",NULL AS "module_name_id","module_name_start","module_name_end","module_name_kind","module_name_source","callee_id","callee_kind","full_callee","callee","receiver","fn","visit_key","resolved","leaf" FROM (SELECT c.*,o.fn,o.visit_key,coalesce(t.value,c.callee) resolved,rx_extract(coalesce(t.value,c.callee),'([^.]+)$',1) leaf FROM calls c JOIN owned_nodes o ON o.__path=c.__path AND o.id=c.id LEFT JOIN terminal_values t ON t.__path=c.__path AND t.fn=o.fn AND t.root=c.callee_id)

stages.name: expression_tags
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","node","kind" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE tag(__path,fn,node,kind) AS (
        SELECT o.__path,o.fn,o.id,'plan' FROM owned_nodes o JOIN terminal_values t ON t.__path=o.__path AND t.fn=o.fn AND t.root=o.id WHERE o.kind IN ('identifier','attribute') AND (t.value GLOB '*plan' OR o.text GLOB '*plan') OR o.kind='call' AND (t.value='plan' OR t.value GLOB '*_plan' OR t.value GLOB '_build_*')
        UNION SELECT o.__path,o.fn,o.id,'lazy' FROM owned_nodes o JOIN terminal_values t ON t.__path=o.__path AND t.fn=o.fn AND t.root=o.id WHERE o.kind='identifier' AND (instr(lower(t.value),'lazy')>0 OR t.value GLOB '*result' OR t.value GLOB '*Intent') OR o.kind IN ('attribute','call') AND (instr(t.value,'lazy')>0 OR t.value GLOB '*result')
        UNION SELECT __path,fn,id,'callable' FROM owned_nodes WHERE kind='lambda'
        UNION SELECT o.__path,o.fn,o.id,'internal' FROM owned_nodes o JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=o.__path AND a.id=o.id WHERE a.attr IN ('_context','_error','_pre_populated','_state','_value') UNION SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,'internal' FROM owned_calls c LEFT JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=1 LEFT JOIN strings s ON s.__path=a.__path AND s.__start=a.__start WHERE c.resolved IN ('_resolved_lazy_revision_value','_literalize_resolved_lazy_result') OR c.resolved IN ('__getattribute__','object.__getattribute__','getattr','builtins.getattr') AND s.value IN ('_context','_error','_pre_populated','_state','_value')
 UNION SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,'dynamic' FROM owned_calls c LEFT JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=CASE WHEN c.callee='get' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LEFT JOIN strings s ON s.__path=a.__path AND s.__start=a.__start LEFT JOIN nodes receiver ON receiver.__path=c.__path AND receiver.id=c.receiver WHERE (c.resolved IN ('getattr','builtins.getattr','__getattribute__','object.__getattribute__') OR c.callee_kind='attribute' AND c.callee='get' AND a.id IS NOT NULL AND NOT (receiver.kind='identifier' AND rx_matches(receiver.text,'^[A-Z_]+$'))) AND a.id IS NOT NULL AND (s.value IS NULL OR rx_matches(lower(s.value),'builder|callable|callback|decoder|factory|hook|method|processor|projector|registry|transform'))
 UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,b.node,t.kind FROM tag t JOIN visible_bindings b ON b.__path=t.__path AND b.fn=t.fn AND b.value=t.node
 UNION SELECT parent.__path,t.fn,parent.id,t.kind FROM tag t JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=t.__path AND child.id=t.node JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=child.__path AND parent.id=child.parent WHERE t.kind IN ('callable','internal') AND (parent.kind IN ('tuple','list','set','dictionary','pair','argument_list','keyword_argument') OR parent.kind='attribute' AND parent.object_id=child.id OR parent.kind='call' AND parent.arguments_id=child.id)) SELECT * FROM tag)

stages.name: classified_calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "alias_id",NULL AS "alias_source",NULL AS "module_name_id","module_name_start","module_name_end","module_name_kind","module_name_source","callee_id","callee_kind","full_callee","callee","receiver","fn","visit_key","resolved","leaf","plan_receiver","lazy_receiver" FROM (SELECT c.*,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM expression_tags t WHERE t.__path=c.__path AND t.fn=c.fn AND t.node=c.receiver AND t.kind='plan') plan_receiver,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM expression_tags t WHERE t.__path=c.__path AND t.fn=c.fn AND t.node=c.receiver AND t.kind='lazy') lazy_receiver FROM owned_calls c)

stages.name: call_targets
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","__start","id","visit_key","target" FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.__start,c.id,c.visit_key,CASE WHEN c.callee_kind='identifier' THEN coalesce(
      (SELECT i.module||'.'||i.name FROM imports i WHERE i.__path=c.__path AND i.local=c.callee AND i.kind='import_from_statement' AND i.fn=c.fn ORDER BY i.__start DESC LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT i.module||'.'||i.name FROM imports i WHERE i.__path=c.__path AND i.local=c.callee AND i.kind='import_from_statement' AND i.fn IS NULL ORDER BY i.__start DESC LIMIT 1),
      replace(substr(c.__path,1,length(c.__path)-3),'/','.')||'.'||coalesce((SELECT a.resolved FROM module_aliases a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.name=c.callee),c.callee))
      WHEN c.callee_kind='attribute' AND receiver.kind='identifier' AND receiver.text IN ('self','cls') AND f.lexical_parent IS NOT NULL THEN
        replace(substr(c.__path,1,length(c.__path)-3),'/','.')||'.'||(SELECT cls.qualname FROM declaration_contexts cls WHERE cls.__path=f.__path AND cls.id=f.lexical_parent)||'.'||
          coalesce((SELECT a.target FROM class_method_aliases a WHERE a.__path=f.__path AND a.cls=f.lexical_parent AND a.name=c.callee ORDER BY a.__start DESC LIMIT 1),c.callee)
      WHEN c.callee_kind='attribute' AND receiver.kind='identifier' THEN (SELECT i.name||'.'||c.callee FROM imports i WHERE i.__path=c.__path AND i.kind='import_statement' AND i.fn IS NULL AND i.local=receiver.text ORDER BY i.__start DESC LIMIT 1) END target FROM owned_calls c JOIN function_flags f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.id=c.fn LEFT JOIN nodes receiver ON receiver.__path=c.__path AND receiver.id=c.receiver)

stages.name: delegate_values
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn",NULL AS "id","__start",NULL AS "__end","keyword_start","callee_kind","callee",NULL AS "callee_id","receiver" FROM (SELECT source.__path,source.fn,source.id,source.__start,source.__end,k.__start keyword_start,node.kind callee_kind,CASE WHEN node.kind='identifier' THEN node.text ELSE node.attribute_source END callee,node.id callee_id,node.object_id receiver FROM owned_calls source JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=source.__path AND k.call=source.id AND k.name IN ('sync_resolve','async_resolve') JOIN nodes node ON node.__path=k.__path AND node.id=k.value WHERE (source.resolved='defer_lazy_result' OR source.resolved GLOB '*.defer_lazy_result') AND node.kind IN ('identifier','attribute'))

stages.name: delegate_targets
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn",NULL AS "id","__start",NULL AS "__end","keyword_start","target" FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,c.keyword_start,CASE WHEN c.callee_kind='identifier' THEN coalesce(
      (SELECT i.module||'.'||i.name FROM imports i WHERE i.__path=c.__path AND i.local=c.callee AND i.kind='import_from_statement' AND i.fn=c.fn ORDER BY i.__start DESC LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT i.module||'.'||i.name FROM imports i WHERE i.__path=c.__path AND i.local=c.callee AND i.kind='import_from_statement' AND i.fn IS NULL ORDER BY i.__start DESC LIMIT 1),
      replace(substr(c.__path,1,length(c.__path)-3),'/','.')||'.'||coalesce((SELECT a.resolved FROM module_aliases a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.name=c.callee),c.callee))
      WHEN c.callee_kind='attribute' AND receiver.kind='identifier' AND receiver.text IN ('self','cls') AND f.lexical_parent IS NOT NULL THEN
        replace(substr(c.__path,1,length(c.__path)-3),'/','.')||'.'||(SELECT cls.qualname FROM declaration_contexts cls WHERE cls.__path=f.__path AND cls.id=f.lexical_parent)||'.'||
          coalesce((SELECT a.target FROM class_method_aliases a WHERE a.__path=f.__path AND a.cls=f.lexical_parent AND a.name=c.callee ORDER BY a.__start DESC LIMIT 1),c.callee)
      WHEN c.callee_kind='attribute' AND receiver.kind='identifier' THEN (SELECT i.name||'.'||c.callee FROM imports i WHERE i.__path=c.__path AND i.kind='import_statement' AND i.fn IS NULL AND i.local=receiver.text ORDER BY i.__start DESC LIMIT 1) END target FROM delegate_values c JOIN function_flags f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.id=c.fn LEFT JOIN nodes receiver ON receiver.__path=c.__path AND receiver.id=c.receiver)

stages.name: architecture_edges

stages.name: side_queue_fields

SELECT "__path","fn","id","__start","__end","category","uses_conn","channel","visit_key","detail","event_kind" FROM (SELECT e.__path,e.fn,e.id,e.__start,e.__end,e.category,e.uses_conn,e.channel,coalesce((SELECT owned.visit_key FROM owned_nodes owned WHERE owned.__path=e.__path AND owned.fn=e.fn AND owned.__start=e.__start AND owned.__end=e.__end LIMIT 1),'') visit_key,
      CASE e.category
      WHEN 'forbidden_pure' THEN 'forbidden @pure_lazy operation '||e.detail
      WHEN 'bootstrap' THEN CASE WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN a.target_kind='attribute' THEN 'attribute' ELSE 'subscript' END||' assignment to '||a.target_text ELSE 'mutating call '||coalesce(c.callee,e.detail)||'(...)' END
      WHEN 'payload' THEN 'callable-tainted payload passed into a ServerPlan service'
      WHEN 'dynamic' THEN CASE WHEN c.resolved IN ('callable','builtins.callable') THEN 'callable() applied to dynamically looked-up behavior' ELSE 'invokes dynamically looked-up behavior inside a ServerPlan service' END
      WHEN 'absence' THEN CASE WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'schema fact absence fallback assigns '||a.expr_text||' to '||a.target_text WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'schema fact absence fallback calls _record_table_exists_result(..., False)' ELSE 'schema fact absence fallback returns LazyResult.of(False)' END
      WHEN 'internal' THEN (SELECT s.value FROM arguments a JOIN strings s ON s.__path=a.__path AND s.__start=a.__start WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=1 LIMIT 1)
      WHEN 'state' THEN (SELECT s.value FROM arguments a JOIN strings s ON s.__path=a.__path AND s.__start=a.__start WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=1 LIMIT 1)
      WHEN 'private' THEN CASE WHEN c.resolved IN ('getattr','builtins.getattr') THEN 'getattr(..., '||quote('_conn')||')' WHEN c.resolved IN ('vars','builtins.vars') THEN 'vars(...)' ELSE e.detail END
      ELSE e.detail END detail,
      CASE WHEN e.category='reconciliation' THEN CASE WHEN e.detail IN ('_get_physical_table_info_for_schema_batch','_introspect_physical_table_for_schema_batch','_list_physical_tables_for_schema_batch','get_table_indexes_lazy','get_table_info_lazy','introspect_table_lazy','list_tables_lazy','materialized_physical_columns','physical_columns_for_reconcile','physical_table_exists_for_reconcile') THEN 'schema discovery' WHEN e.detail IN ('_execute_direct_internal_lazy','_execute_schema_ddl','_execute_schema_ddl_lazy','_execute_schema_direct_internal_lazy','flush_schema_plan') THEN 'direct DDL or schema plan flush' ELSE 'lazy callback trampoline' END END event_kind
      FROM (SELECT e.__path,e.fn,e.id,e.__start,e.__end,e.category,e.channel,
      CASE WHEN e.category='plan' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM classified_calls c
        JOIN nodes receiver ON receiver.__path=c.__path AND receiver.id=c.receiver AND receiver.kind='identifier'
        JOIN native_cursor_parameters p ON p.__path=c.__path AND p.fn=c.fn AND p.name=receiver.text
        WHERE c.__path=e.__path AND c.fn=e.fn AND c.id=e.id AND c.callee IN ('fetchone','fetchmany','fetchall'))
        THEN 'native_cursor.'||e.detail ELSE e.detail END detail,
        e.category='plan' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM classified_calls c WHERE c.__path=e.__path AND c.id=e.id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attributes attr WHERE attr.__path=c.__path AND attr.attr='_conn' AND (
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=0 AND attr.__start>=a.__start AND attr.__end<=a.__end)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND k.name IN ('owner','txn','tx','conn','connection') AND attr.__start>=k.__start AND attr.__end<=k.__end)))) SELECT e.*,9 channel FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'forbidden_pure' category,c.leaf detail FROM classified_calls c WHERE c.leaf IN ('_ensure_internal_raw_access')) e UNION ALL SELECT e.*,10 channel FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'reconciliation' category,c.leaf detail FROM classified_calls c WHERE c.leaf IN ('_execute_direct_internal_lazy','_execute_schema_ddl','_execute_schema_ddl_lazy','_execute_schema_direct_internal_lazy','_get_physical_table_info_for_schema_batch','_introspect_physical_table_for_schema_batch','_list_physical_tables_for_schema_batch','_schema_operation_lazy','flush_schema_plan','get_table_indexes_lazy','get_table_info_lazy','introspect_table_lazy','list_tables_lazy','materialized_physical_columns','physical_columns_for_reconcile','physical_table_exists_for_reconcile') AND NOT (c.leaf='flush_schema_plan' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM function_flags f WHERE f.__path=c.__path AND f.id=c.fn AND (f.name IN ('_bulk_schema_plan_context','_commit_schema_transaction','_create_fts_index_schema_sync','create_table_from_schema','drop_table') OR f.qualname IN stages.name: intrinsic
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","id","location","reason" FROM (SELECT __path,id,location,reason FROM (
      SELECT f.__path,f.id,e.__start location,
        CASE e.category WHEN 'context' THEN 'ExecutionContext terminal ' WHEN 'internal' THEN 'reads LazyResult internals ' WHEN 'state' THEN 'writes execution-derived planner state ' WHEN 'private' THEN 'reaches through private runtime state via ' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'direct eager sink ' ELSE 'imperative native call ' END||e.detail reason,
        row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.id ORDER BY CASE e.category WHEN 'context' THEN 0 WHEN 'internal' THEN 1 WHEN 'state' THEN 2 WHEN 'private' THEN 3 WHEN 'plan' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,e.visit_key,e.channel) chosen
      FROM function_flags f JOIN function_events e ON e.__path=f.__path AND e.fn=f.id WHERE e.category IN ('plan','native') OR f.sensitive AND e.category IN ('context','state','private') OR f.sensitive AND e.category='internal' AND f.name NOT IN ()
      ) WHERE chosen=1 UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id,f.__start,CASE WHEN f.legacy THEN 'legacy eager wrapper' WHEN rx_matches(f.text,'^async\b') AND NOT f.pure THEN 'async function' ELSE 'name ends with _async' END FROM function_flags f
      WHERE (f.legacy OR rx_matches(f.text,'^async\b') AND NOT f.pure OR f.name GLOB '*_async') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM function_events e WHERE e.__path=f.__path AND e.fn=f.id AND (e.category IN ('plan','native') OR f.sensitive AND e.category IN ('context','state','private') OR f.sensitive AND e.category='internal' AND f.name NOT IN ())))
